# `•element` — XML elements

`•element tag` returns an element function for the XML tag `tag`. Call it with attributes on the left and children on the right, as in `["r":10] circle ""`. An empty right argument, `""` or `⍬`, gives no children. The result is a keyed vector with `tag`, `attrs` and `children` entries. Notebooks display it as HTML. [XML and SVG](../xml.ipynb) covers element trees.

Errors: `DOMAIN` for invalid tag or attribute names.
